import ipaddress
import json
import re
import socket
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from src.infra.memoize import TTLCache

# 15-minute URL cache: repeat fetches of the same page inside the window
# (agent retries, sub-agents re-reading a source) skip the network round
# trip. Successful extractions only - errors and SSRF blocks are never
# cached (the memoize module invariant: a failure must not persist for the
# TTL). Catalog tools exec in-process at boot, so importing engine infra
# is the platform-tool norm.
URL_CACHE_TTL_S = 900
url_cache = TTLCache(default_ttl=URL_CACHE_TTL_S)

BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = frozenset({
    "localhost",
    "localhost.localdomain",
    "metadata.google.internal",
})

BLOCKED_HOSTNAME_SUFFIXES = (
    ".localhost",
    ".local",
    ".internal",
)


def _validate_url(url):
    """Validate a URL for SSRF. Returns error message or None if safe."""
    try:
        parsed = urlparse(url)
    except Exception:
        return "Malformed URL"

    if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
        return f"Scheme '{parsed.scheme}' is not allowed — only http and https"

    hostname = parsed.hostname
    if not hostname:
        return "No hostname in URL"

    hostname_lower = hostname.lower().rstrip(".")

    if hostname_lower in BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES:
        return f"Hostname '{hostname}' is blocked"
    for suffix in BLOCKED_HOSTNAME_SUFFIXES:
        if hostname_lower.endswith(suffix):
            return f"Hostname '{hostname}' is blocked"

    try:
        addr_info = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, socket.AF_UNSPEC, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    except socket.gaierror:
        return f"Cannot resolve hostname '{hostname}'"

    for family, _, _, _, sockaddr in addr_info:
        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(sockaddr[0])
        if ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local or ip.is_reserved:
            return f"Resolved IP {ip} is blocked (private/loopback/link-local/reserved)"

    return None


async def handler(params):
    """Fetch and extract readable content from a URL."""
    url = params.get("url", "")
    if not url:
        return "Error: url required"
    violation = _validate_url(url)
    if violation:
        return f"Error: blocked URL — {violation}"
    cached = url_cache.get(url)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    try:
        import httpx
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30, follow_redirects=True) as client:
            resp = await client.get(url, headers={"User-Agent": "IntelligenceEngine/1.0"})
            resp.raise_for_status()
            content_type = resp.headers.get("content-type", "")
            if "text/html" in content_type:
                text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', resp.text, flags=re.DOTALL)
                text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL)
                text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)
                text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
                result = text[:10000]
            else:
                result = resp.text[:10000]
            url_cache.set(url, result)
            return result
    except ImportError:
        return "Error: httpx not installed — run 'pip install httpx'"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error fetching {url}: {e}"
